title: Gab Going to Alleviate Indecisiveness
description: A massive, rusted metallic capsule-like structure with riveted panels and corroded greenish-brown patina stands atop a decaying wooden post. Tattered white banners wrapped around the scene display the text 'GAB GOING TO ALLEVIATE INDECISIVENESS' against a dark, stormy sky with swirling clouds and a glowing full moon.
